resources.string: Local metadata only; no upload. Platform, privacy and audience are intentions, not cloud settings. Target apps may ignore prefill; paste and check manually. Covers are not included in JSON and must be selected again after import.
No drafts. An export draft is created only when you tap Publication draft.
Tags (one per line; maximum 30, 500 characters total)

Choose only if you hold the required rights. YouTube Standard applies to YouTube; check terms on other platforms. This selection grants no rights, uploads nothing, and does not ensure the platform applies it. CC0 music does not make the whole video CC0; music provenance is retained separately.
Music credits / rights captured at export
Handed to share UI, not confirmed uploaded. Share cancellation cannot be detected.
Copy all (including license intention and music credits)
Copied; paste manually in the target app
Target may ignore prefill; not an upload
Delete only this draft metadata, never the video or cover?
Close and cancel current work? Saved drafts remain; completed writes cannot be undone.
Unsaved changes. Save, discard, or keep editing?
Reading / saving locally… Large videos are streamed; go back to cancel.
Computing full SHA-256. Bytes read: %1$d. Back cancels; only byte-identical files match.
Matching draft count: %1$d. Review provenance and choose one; alternatives remain unchanged
Keep this export evidence in a separate draft (retain alternatives)

Matches full-byte SHA-256 and size, not visual similarity. Encoding or editing usually changes the hash. Providers can still mutate files; sharing checks readability and size, not the entire hash every time. Verify again if the file may have changed.
Video unbound, deleted or permission revoked. Metadata retained; sharing unavailable. Explicitly select a video; the latest export is never substituted.
Operation failed; check fields or file permission. Previous draft retained unless a write already completed.
Filename exceeds 100 characters; initial title shortened. Full filename retained. Please review the title.

Video bytes differ or the old binding is unverified. Original text, cover and provenance remain unchanged. Find another draft or create a separate one for this video? Original music credits will not be assigned to different content.
Rebound media: music rights unknown; verify permission. CC0 is not assumed.
